source: MAFF/partner document, "ដំណំពោត" (Corn Crop), Section IV.1: Seed selection
text: When selecting corn seed for planting, farmers should choose seed that: gives high yield; has purity above 95%; has a germination rate above 85%; is fresh seed (not stored for many years/seasons); and is resistant to disease and pest damage, and does not shatter/split easily.
